if [ -z "$PREFIRE_CLI" ] || [ "$PREFIRE_CLI" != "$PREFIRE_PKG" ]; then
  echo "mise.toml pins prefire '$PREFIRE_CLI' but Apps/Project.swift pins '$PREFIRE_PKG' — bump both together." >&2
  exit 1
fi
# xcodebuild resolves the whole Tuist workspace into Package.resolved; a plain

done

---
name: package-resolved-originhash-churn
description: "Package.resolved's originHash regenerates to a different value in this workspace than what is committed — don't commit the churn, it only creates merge conflicts"
metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 298c8363-2109-4e59-931e-5ce44be0d5de
  modified: 2026-08-11T08:20:15.149Z
---

Every resolve in this worktree writes an `originHash` into `Package.resolved` that differs
from the committed one, whichever build system did it (`swift test` and `xcodebuild` agree
with each other and disagree with `HEAD`). Measured twice on 2026-08-11: `HEAD` held
`0e5f13…` while local runs produced `529c37…`, and after merging main's `d0a3294…` local
runs produced `450f00…`. The pin count is unaffected — 25 either way — so this is a
different phenomenon from the 20↔25 pin oscillation `CLAUDE.md` documents.

**Why:** committing the local value gains nothing and guarantees a conflict: main's copy
carries whatever hash main's environment produced, and `originHash` also moves for real
whenever `Package.swift` gains a target, so the two reasons are indistinguishable in a
diff. One such commit here was nullified by the very next merge.

**How to apply:** after a verification run leaves `Package.resolved` dirty with only the
`originHash` line changed, `git checkout -- Package.resolved`. Commit it only when the pin
*list* changed. `mise run lint` reads `HEAD`, not the tree, so a dirty tree never fails it.
Related: [[tear-down-sim-and-daemon]].

content.text:
`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
Все три PR падают на одном и том же: **`Package.resolved` осциллирует между двумя системами сборки**. Dependabot резолвит только корневой пакет через SwiftPM — а тот знает 20 пинов; пять «воркспейсных» (Prefire, snapshot-testing, swift-syntax, custom-dump, issue-reporting) добавляет только `xcodebuild`, резолвящий весь Tuist-воркспейс. Проверка в `mise.toml` читает **HEAD**, а не рабочее дерево, именно потому, что дерево законно колеблется.

Второе, что здесь важно: резолвер уважает уже записанные пины, но не восстанавливает их «правильно» с нуля. Резолв с чистого листа выбрал `swift-custom-dump 1.7.0` + `xctest-dynamic-overlay` вместо `1.7.3` + `swift-issue-reporting` (пакет переименован в апстриме, идентичности разные) — то есть порядок операций решает: сначала вернуть пять пинов, потом дать `xcodebuild` их подтвердить.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`

Собрал все три бампа в одну ветку и восстановил 25-пиновый файл. Теперь коммит и локальная проверка:

name: dependabot-prs-always-fail-the-pin-check
description: "Every dependabot PR here fails Lint & Test on the workspace pins; fix them as one combined branch, and restore the pins before resolving"
metadata:

Dependabot resolves the root package with SwiftPM alone, so every one of its PRs
writes a 20-pin `Package.resolved` and drops the five Xcode-workspace pins. The
`mise run lint` check reads `HEAD` and fails all of them, while the four heavy
jobs pass — the code is never the problem. Measured on #133/#134/#135
(2026-09-07).

**Why:** fixing them one at a time costs a 13-minute CI run each and the second
PR then conflicts with the first on the same file. One branch carrying every
bump is one run and one merge; dependabot closes its own PRs once the versions
land on main.

**How to apply:** bump the requirement in `Package.swift`, run
`swift package update <names>` for the bumped packages only (a bare
`swift package update` moves the whole graph), then restore the five missing
pin blocks from `git show HEAD:Package.resolved` and run
`xcodebuild -resolvePackageDependencies -workspace Apps/ReachyMiniApps.xcworkspace
-scheme ReachyMini -derivedDataPath Apps/DerivedData` to confirm the merge — it
leaves the file byte-identical when the set is valid.

**Do not** restore the pins by resolving the workspace from scratch: with the
five entries absent, the resolver picks `swift-custom-dump` 1.7.0 plus
`xctest-dynamic-overlay` instead of 1.7.3 plus `swift-issue-reporting` (the same
upstream repository under two identities), which is an unrelated downgrade in a
dependency-bump diff. Order decides the answer.

Local `mise run build` cannot verify any of this — it selects the swift.org
toolchain and fails on `LongRunningIntent`. Use `xcrun swift build`, which is
Xcode's Swift and the configuration CI uses. Related:
[[package-resolved-originhash-churn]], [[main-is-unprotected-auto-merge-does-not-wait]].

Пока CI гоняет #136 (~13 минут), коротко о состоянии:

**Что было не так.** Все три PR (#133, #134, #135) — от dependabot, и все три падали на одном и том же шаге `Lint & Test`, за 30 секунд:

```
Package.resolved at HEAD lost the Xcode-workspace pin 'prefire'
```

Тяжёлые джобы (App Build macOS/iOS, Preview, Smoke) проходили везде — то есть ни WebRTC 152, ни патчи OpenAPI код не ломают. Ломался только `Package.resolved`.

**Что сделано.** Одна ветка вместо трёх: `chore/bump-webrtc-152-openapi-patches` → PR #136 с бампами WebRTC 150→152, openapi-generator 1.13.0→1.13.1, openapi-runtime 1.12.0→1.12.1 и 25-пиновым `Package.resolved`. Локально `xcrun swift build` зелёный (через Swift от Xcode — `mise run build` на этой машине берёт swift.org-тулчейн и падает на `LongRunningIntent`, это ожидаемо и к бампу отношения не имеет).

Три исходных PR закрою после мержа #136.
